snippet.title: MetalMercs – Official Gameplay Trailer | Mercenary Mech Strategy (Free Demo)
snippet.description:
MetalMercs releases March 2027, and a new free demo has just been released! 

Wishlist and Play the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045070/MetalMercs/

MetalMercs is a real-time tactical mech game with pause. Command your mercenary company, take contracts, customize your mechs, and salvage the battlefield to keep your outfit fighting.

Watch for the re-launched beta demo this November!

#MetalMercs #MechGames #IndieGames

Music: Punch Deck - Hollow Sun
